title: Dashboard
cmd: [ "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '{{HTTP}}' '{{BASE}}/dashboard')" = "200" ] && out=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/dashboard') && echo "$out" | grep -q 'Monitor' && out=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/dashboard') && echo "$out" | grep -q 'Providers'

title: Nav groups ordered Work/Gateway/Monitor/Admin
cmd: curl -s "{{BASE}}/work/tasks" | python3 -c "import sys; h=sys.stdin.read(); w=h.find('nav-label\">Work'); g=h.find('nav-label\">Gateway'); m=h.find('nav-label\">Monitor'); a=h.find('nav-label\">Admin'); assert -1 < w < g < m < a, (w,g,m,a)"

title: /api/work/tasks?lite=1&per=5
cmd: [ "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '{{HTTP}}' '{{BASE}}/api/work/tasks?lite=1&per=5')" = "200" ] && curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/tasks?lite=1&per=5' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d.get('tasks') is not None, 'missing key tasks'"
